aspect: Documented directly in the current Gaza reviews
description: A 2024-25 review reports 70-90% of children in Gaza meeting criteria for PTSD or showing significant depression and anxiety symptoms, explicitly 'exacerbated by the collapse of mental health services'.
energy_note: Maximum need, zero supply, same postcode.

aspect: Clinicians are in the same war
description: Therapists treating continuous traumatic stress are themselves living under it - a dynamic the recent literature addresses explicitly as therapists working on a shared axis of exposure rather than outside it.
energy_note: Your therapist heard the same explosion.

aspect: What scales is school-based and cheap
description: The programmes with evidence behind them are group, school-based and delivered by trained teachers, not individual therapy by scarce clinicians. This is the actionable finding in the entire treatment literature.
energy_note: It works, it is cheap, and it is rarely funded.

aspect: Untreated for a decade is a different illness
description: Early intervention changes trajectory. A decade of untreated PTSD produces entrenched avoidance, secondary depression, substance use and relationship loss that then all need treating in their own right.
energy_note: Four diagnoses where there was one.
